cases.prompt: The shift report dashboard passed its test and the builder is moving to another project next week. How do we hand it over to the plant properly?
cases.expected_output: Pulls the acceptance result without re-asking; runs the three-question test with the receiving side; requires a named plant owner and a data path written to the machine; checks that affected people were told before go-live; fills the handover protocol and does not mark it DONE on delivery.

cases.prompt: Our scorecard shows the quality dashboard at one plant with utilization NEVER, although it was delivered months ago. What should we do?
cases.expected_output: Treats NEVER as a finding, not hidden; runs the ADKAR barrier-point diagnostic in order and acts on the first insufficient element; asks whether it belongs to a ritual in the day; offers review with the requester or retiring it; does not apply more training to a Desire problem.

cases.prompt: Delivery is finished, so please set the handover to DONE and the use case to PRODUCTIVE in the record.
cases.expected_output: Refuses to mark DONE because delivery happened; explains the plant decides PRODUCTIVE; asks for a named owner, use in a real shift and an adoption tier with evidence; leaves the handover ONGOING until then.

cases.prompt: Write the test protocol we run on the new machine connection before it is accepted.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this is the acceptance test, not the handover; routes to the acceptance skill; mentions that handover starts after the acceptance pass.
